newsitem.title: USA: Guidant new lead implanted as study begins.
newsitem.headline: Guidant new lead implanted as study begins.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Thursday the first ENDOTAK PICOTIP endocardial defibrillation lead was implanted in the start of a clinical study to evaluate the device.
The lead is designed to increase device longevity by as much as 10 percent for patients who receive significant pacing therapy.
Guidant said the first implant occurred at Summit Medical Center, Oakland, Calif., in an elderly male patient with coronary artery disease, fast heart rhythms and an enlarged heart.
